_meta.note: For coding agents (SWE-Bench, Terminal-Bench and similar). Same five portable questions as sre.v1, so the two are comparable on everything except this phase question.

phase.instructions: What is this step of the work doing? Judge the action that was taken and what it returned. Pick the single best description.

criteria.survey: Looking broadly at the repository without a specific target yet, such as listing files or searching widely.
criteria.localize: Narrowing from the whole repository to the specific file, function or line at issue.
criteria.read: Reading one specific piece of source, configuration or documentation in detail.
criteria.reproduce: Running something in order to make the reported failure happen.
criteria.test: Running tests or checks to see whether the code now behaves as intended.
criteria.revert: Undoing or rolling back an earlier change.
criteria.report: Writing up or submitting a conclusion rather than working on the code.
